question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. R has an exam on Thursday. No one has an exam before V. U has an exam immediately before R, but after S. Q has an exam before T but after P. How many people have exams between S and T?
